Main_actual_findings: Flower extends ordinary Block, with random tick registration AGE<5; no own Bonemealable interface. AGE5 stops natural growth but remains subject to support repair, not an immediate dead-item state.
Above AIR, above Y<max and AGE<5 precede Forge pre at above/old state with default true. ALLOW cannot bypass those outer gates; randomTick is not a complete canSurvive check.
Immediate END_STONE/additional-ground tag admits vertical flag without setting the rooted-column flag. Below AIR also admits vertical selection; no whole-network ground requirement follows.

Plant-column tracing starts j=1, checks at most four steps below(j+1), and recognizes ground only at its first nonplant. That bounded root flag affects nextInt(5 versus4) and lateral attempts, not a whole graph scan.

Vertical needs the selected flag, all horizontal neighbors of above AIR and above2 AIR. It requests old flower to plant and above flower with the SAME age, then event1033, without successful-write verification.

Only failed vertical selection and age<4 permit lateral trials: random0..3 plus rooted bonus, possibly repeated directions. Target and below must be AIR; neighbor test ignores the direction back toward the parent.

A qualified lateral target requests child AGE+1 and marks success independently of setBlock return. Any qualified target requests parent plant; otherwise parent AGE5/event1034. Age4 can still extend vertically.
Forge post uses old flower position/state after selection, including terminal branch. Events and qualified-target flags are not committed growth or rollback receipts.
Flower survival below plant/ground is immediate. With below AIR it instead requires exactly one horizontal plant and other sides AIR. A flower neighbor does not count as plant.
Flower updateShape excludes UP from its own bad-support schedule; deferred tick rechecks before destroy. This does not establish an irreversible immediate break.

Plant connection booleans include adjacent plant/flower and downward ground, but plant survival is a separate algorithm. Above and below nonAIR plus any horizontal plant can return false before own-ground fallback.

Alternatively a horizontal plant supported below can permit survival before own support fallback. A delayed bad-support tick is not proof of a fully evaluated cascading network. PipeBlock geometry remains unread.

Worldgen requests origin plant then void recursion. Root segments use2..5, children1..4; depth<4 and strict XZ<8 against original origin govern branches. Segment loop checks four side neighbors but not own-cell AIR or an explicit Y bound.

Worldgen sets branch flag before unchecked writes/recursive call. Child may return early, so branch selected is not guaranteed terminal flower. With no qualifying branch the top requests AGE5. Initial placement and connection writes remain unchecked.
Feature requires origin AIR and exact END_STONE, not the additional ground tag. It invokes void generation then returns true, not a placement count or verified terminal network.
Placed JSON count uniform0..4/inSquare/MOTION_BLOCKING/biome is source-only; full Count/UniformInt and currently merged biomes are unread. A purpur recipe is not a building reference.
Projectile path requires server, mayInteract and IMPACT_PROJECTILES, then destroyBlock with that projectile as source. Not all projectiles, not a confirmed item receipt, and not a strict entity kill.

Flower loot conditions are AND: survivesExplosion plus this-entity predicate{}. THIS resolves THIS_ENTITY. EntityPredicate.fromJson({}) builds a new predicate, not the identity singleton ANY; matches rejects null after its ANY identity check.

Nonnull source entity is therefore necessary, not proved sufficient: all default imported subpredicate semantics remain unread. Do not infer player-only, any-nonnull unconditional pass or guaranteed projectile drops.
LevelWriter two-arg destroy delegates null source; three-arg supplies depth512. Support destruction versus projectile destruction has a real context difference, still not a native loot guarantee.

Level.destroyBlock invokes drops before final setBlock success; this selected source order is not a demonstrated duplication exploit. On success it emits game event; server Block.dropResources forwards optional THIS_ENTITY then popResource/spawnAfterBreak.
Complete LootParams defaults, full loot backend, gamerules/popResource/admission and ItemEntity UUID pickup remain unclosed. Plant uniform0..1 count then decay is not verified harvest quantity.
Fruit smelting200/experience.1 and4 popped fruit to4 purpur are static consumers. Fuel debit, XP, survival availability, paid transaction, food teleport and native acquisition are outside this read.
